All tests pass! I've added two new functions to `src/invoices.js`:

**`lineTotal(line)`** – calculates qty × unitPrice for a single line item.

**`invoiceTotals(invoice)`** – returns `{ subtotal, total }` by summing all line totals. For now, total equals subtotal (VAT calculations will come later).

Added 7 comprehensive tests covering edge cases (single units, multiple items, zero prices) and verifying immutability. All 31 tests pass. ✅
